kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نستعرب (form X)
# نَسْتَعْرِبُ (nastaʕribu) /nas.taʕ.ri.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْرَبَ (istaʕraba)
# نَسْتَعْرِبَ (nastaʕriba) /nas.taʕ.ri.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْرَبَ (istaʕraba)
# نَسْتَعْرِبْ (nastaʕrib) /nas.taʕ.rib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَعْرَبَ (istaʕraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
